newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus central bank to auction 5-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus central bank to auction 5-yr bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus has started to accept bids for a five-year government bond issue, due on Wednesday, worth up to 33 million pounds ($62.9 million).
Competitive and noncompetitive bids can be made to the central bank until 9.00 a.m local (0600 GMT) on Wednesday. The bonds will have a July 16 issue date.

In competitive bidding, bidders state the price at which they are prepared to buy the bonds. Bids are accepted in part or in whole only if they are higher or equal to the central bank's set minimum bid for the specific issue. The minimum bid is set at 10,000 pounds.
Non-competitive bidding is when the bidder will pay the average price of all competitive bids accepted by the central bank. The mimimum is set at 1,000 pounds.
The bonds are priced at par.
The bonds represent the third tranche of development bonds, which will float on the Cyprus Stock Exchange this year. They have a seven-percent coupon payable half-yearly. ($=0.52 pound)
